mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% consistently signals a restrictive monetary policy environment, which compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates and increased risk aversion, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI index above 305.0 (indicating persistent inflation) triggers a negative market reaction due to expectations of prolonged high interest rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 305.0, or the rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of a federal funds rate above 5.0% and CPI index above 305.0 (indicating restrictive policy and persistent inflation) creates a 'dovish' market sentiment that compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0 AND CPIAUCSL > 305.0, or the rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a strong economic growth regime (as indicated by annualized GDP growth above 2%), a housing market strength (HOUST > 1500) signals robust consumer demand and positive equity returns, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1500 AND GDPC1 growth > 2%, or the rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 3.5%) signals a tight labor market and strong economic growth, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in less than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5%, or the rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A strong industrial production index (INDPRO > 105) signals robust manufacturing activity and positive economic momentum, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 60% of instances when INDPRO > 105.0, or the rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of a low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 3.5%) and federal funds rate above 5.0% (indicating a tight labor market and restrictive policy) creates a 'stagflation' risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5% AND FEDFUNDS > 5.0, or the rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A retail sales index above 700000 (indicating strong consumer spending) signals robust economic activity and positive equity returns, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
